china-1929-30:p0463_1.rationale: French Concession of Shameen: council, officials, area, foreign/Chinese population and revenue; a foreign-administered settlement in a nominally sovereign state. Mixed text and figures, so statistical.

china-1929-30:p0463_2.rationale: British Concession of Shameen: council, officials, area, population, revenue sources and expenditure; a foreign concession. Mixed text and figures.

china-1929-30:p0465_1.rationale: Monthly prevalence of named communicable diseases by province, 1927-28, in graded signs and some case counts. Statistical (graded) observations; a disease-occurrence survey rather than an outbreak study.

china-1929-30:p0478_1.rationale: Amoy deaths from notifiable diseases (plague, smallpox, cholera etc.) for 1926-1928.

china-1929-30:p0481_1.rationale: Status of mission hospitals in 1927 under Southern and Northern governments, with counts and percentages (normal, temporary, seized, closed).
review_questions: Mission hospitals could fit a missions tag but the table is about hospital operating status, so none was added.

china-1929-30:p0481_2.rationale: List of departments of the Ministry of Health with romanized and Chinese names; organisational description, not statistical.

china-1929-30:p0483_1.rationale: Textual list of initial measures of the Ministry of Health (national board, laboratory, health officer training, maritime quarantine). Mixed items, none dominant enough for a single tag.
review_questions: Would a health-administration tag be proposed for public health policy lists?

china-1929-30:p0484_1.rationale: Outline of the chapters and sections of the Sanitary Code and appendices on health administration programmes; textual, covering sanitation, disease control, midwives, food and practitioners.

china-1929-30:p0487_1.rationale: Maritime Customs revenue 1919-1928 by duty type (import, export, coast trade, tonnage, transit, opium likin, famine surtax) in Hk. Tls.

china-1929-30:p0487_2.rationale: Maritime Customs revenue apportioned between foreign and home trades, 1919-1927, with duties on Chinese produce exported; second half of the customs revenue table.
